title: This teapot arrived without a lid and there is no customer service or  manufacturer  to contact
text:
This teapot arrived without a lid and there is no customer service or manufacturer to contact. This teapot seems nice but it arrived without a lid and I cannot use it effectively as a result. Also, there is no customer service. I tried the warranty and support section of the Amazon product page but only got a message to "Please contact the seller directly for warranty information for this product. You may also be able to find warranty information on the manufacturer’s website." I was unable to find a manufacturer site and have not had any luck contacting Amazon--at least not yet.

I will update my review if I have any resolution to this missing part but as it stands now, this is another item that is ready to be thrown out and a loss of money. I am thoroughly dissappointed because this looks like a nice pot.

I have some food storage containers that are Miocaro and they are five stars. Unfortunately, if a product is shipped with missing parts, no matter how good the product could be, it becomes a useless or almost useless product when pieces are missing.
